title: Explicit endpoint comparisons and pointwise exactness of the Roos sequence
statement: Let A be an abelian category with countable limits and exact countable products. For every inverse tower K of unbounded cochain complexes and every integer q, construct a(K,q): C(H^(q-1)(K)) -> H^q(Cone(1-T)[-1]) and b(K,q): H^q(Cone(1-T)[-1]) -> lim H^q(K). The first is the factorization of the cone connecting morphism through its cokernel, transported along the product/homology comparison; the second is the cone projection factored through its kernel, transported along the kernel-to-limit isomorphism. Then a(K,q)b(K,q)=0 and this pair is short exact. The tower constructions are [def-pe-milnor-towers], the abelian category structure is [def-sp-abelian], products are [def-weil-category-product], and the inverse limit is [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit].

proof.text: Apply the distinguished mapping-cocone triangle long exact sequence to 1-T on the product. The three adjacent short complexes are exact.

In any abelian category an exact five-term segment factors to a short exact sequence from the cokernel of its first map to the kernel of its last map. Monicity and epicity follow from the adjacent exactness statements; middle exactness is transported along the cokernel epi and kernel mono.

The homology functor preserves countable products because these products are exact. Use the projection comparison, and check each component to show that it conjugates the cohomology transition endomorphism to 1-T. Kernel and cokernel mapIso transport the endpoints.

A compatible family into a tower product is exactly a map killed by 1-T. The kernel fork therefore has the limit universal property. Transport the factored short exact sequence along these endpoint isomorphisms.

theorem milnor_shortExact [HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) A]
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ h : milnorInclusion K q ≫ milnorProjection K q = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk (milnorInclusion K q) (milnorProjection K q) h).ShortExact
